issues.on_page: Lincoln Electric System enterprise column: Charges for Services 359,817,000; Total Operating Revenues 382,769,000; Operating Expenses 281,684,000; Net Position 637,099,000
issues.issue: The city's business-type totals include LES, which has its own report (Lincoln_Electric_System_FY2025). Adding the two reports together double counts LES. decision_needed[] doesn't have this question.

The label says reimbursement, and 'reimbursements/refunds' exists as a category. The amounts (e.g., West Haymarket JPA 10,321,429) look like reimbursed service costs, so charges for services is defensible. Judgment call; also applies to detail[6], detail[42], detail[58], detail[63] (p5-7, p17).
About 47.1M of this line is in the Federal Grants Fund column, so it is likely federal. It is kept whole as state aid with review. A person should decide whether to split it by fund column.
The grantor isn't stated; it could be federal grants. Already marked for review.
Street fund intergovernmental revenue is normally mostly state highway allocation ('highway allocation'). The page doesn't break it down, so this is a judgment call.
